cards.hint: Recall the list of limits that keep energy loss out of the flow
cards.quote: the restrictions for this form are that the flow is inviscid, incompressible, steady, without heat addition
cards.stem: Which flow condition is required for this form of the equation

cards.hint: Think of the kinetic energy form with density and speed
options: density times the square of the velocity divided by two
internal energy plus pressure times specific volume
total enthalpy minus useful work done
random motion plus ordered momentum loss
cards.quote: The form of the dynamic pressure is the density times the square of the velocity divided by two.
cards.stem: How is dynamic pressure described in words in the flow

cards.hint: Consider what combined pressure loads produce on the foil
options: useful work done by the fluid
cards.quote: The static pressure integrated along the entire surface of the airfoil gives the total aerodynamic force on the foil.
cards.stem: What is obtained by integrating static pressure over the airfoil surface

cards.hint: Look for the speedometer name linked to static and total pressure
cards.quote: Bernoulli’s equation is also used on aircraft to provide a speedometer called a pitot-static tube.
cards.stem: Which device uses pressure readings to indicate aircraft speed
